versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-waf-quick-showcase 0.0.2

- Enforces Aliyun CLI version >= 3.3.3 and requires explicit plugin updates before workflow.
- Adds mandatory configuration steps for "AI-Mode" before and after running CLI commands.
- Requires all aliyun CLI commands to include a specific user-agent flag for tracking.
- Updates pre-flight checks and installation guide to reflect new CLI and plugin requirements.
- Improves clarity in scenario rules and step instructions for enhanced user experience and guidance.

alibabacloud-waf-quick-showcase 0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Enables rapid deployment of a secure web application environment on Alibaba Cloud ECS, integrating WAF for protection.
- Supports two main scenarios: full quick-start environment and integration with existing WAF instances.
- Includes strict pre-flight checks (CLI version, authentication, account balance) and mandatory user confirmation before creating resources.
- Enforces robust parameter confirmation and validation for network and instance settings, prioritizing security best practices.
- Explicitly prevents handling of confidential credentials and disallows integrating existing ECS instances.
